inputs.validation: Exact selected IDs, declared original audio SHA against manifest, independent source/copied reference hashes, optional saved evidence hashes; external audio not rehashed by this report

scope: Saved host outputs only; no inference, no summary.json reads, no excluded split case/reference reads. Utterance-interval DER/timing proxy is not natural-dialogue or word-timestamp acceptance. Host RTF is not phone performance.

timing.scope: Utterance/clip-bound reference proxy; global medians across matched pairs. Not word-timestamp acceptance; always inspect coverage.
